shots.content: Light-skinned woman at a vanity doing makeup; DERMDOC tube AND its carton on the vanity; hook 'SKIN PROTECTION DEPARTMENT'.
shots.note: L1 'Team, we've got a full day ahead.' is spoken by the tube (team manager), so open on the talking tube mascot on a sunny morning marble vanity, which is the same setting. Use 0.0-2.6 s of the clip.

shots.content: Cartoon villain gang at the window (angry sun, white-cast blob with bucket, golden oil drop, grey dullness cloud).
shots.note: Cartoon villains only, with no product and no skin. Matches L2 'Let's ruin her work day!'.

shots.content: Tube mascot held by a fair hand: the cap end is open with a lavender cream ribbon pouring out and a loose lid disc beside it. SPF shield, purple droplet and niacinamide characters below.
shots.note: L3 'Everyone knows their assignment.' cuts to the assignment: Meera's face with five neat lavender dots, about to blend (application step 1). Use 0-2.5 s.

shots.content: 7.1 s close-up of a light-skinned woman's face with a niacinamide character and a grey cloud on her cheek.
shots.note: Covered by two library clips. (a) 7.6-11.0 GRAPHIC_COLOUR_WHEEL on PSA2_avatar_point. During L4 'I've got the UV rays' the empty right side shows the SPF 50 PA+++ card. At 9.4, on new L5, a CORRECT wheel animates in on the right (purple directly opposite yellow; arrow purple to yellow; yellow segment dims). (b) 11.0-14.73 PS05_blend_glow: the dots blend in invisibly and her dusky skin turns even and dewy with an Instant Glow. It plays under L6 (niacinamide, instant glow) and L7 'Team, protection complete.'

shots.content: Light-skinned woman walking in the city holding an oversized tube, with the hero characters at her feet.
shots.note: L8 'Instant glow. Ready for the day.' plays over Meera on a sunny balcony with the ONE tube mascot waving. She touches her glowing cheek, so the video ends on a glowing face plus the exact product. Use 0-2.3 s.

script_changes.new_en: And I've got the instant glow.
script_changes.reason: Say 'Instant Glow'. Avoids repeating 'dullness' after the new L5.

script_changes.new_en: Instant glow. Ready for the day.
script_changes.reason: Instant Glow named on the after/glow shot. There is 1.1 s of slack before 17.02.

Card in PSA2's empty right half while the SPF shield speaks L4.

supers.text: PURPLE SITS OPPOSITE YELLOW / CANCELS YELLOW-LOOKING DULLNESS

Label the glow result on the final face.

voice_changes.speaker: uv_rays
voice_changes.why: Villain voice pitched -3 st (male/scary). Use a female voice and drop the negative pitch shift, keeping it playful.

summary: Keep the villain-gang shot. Replace the non-dusky woman everywhere and the open-cap/pouring tube with the PSA1 mascot, PS04 dots, the colour-wheel graphic, PS05 blend and PSA3 Meera+mascot. Purple tint now explains purple vs yellow, and 'Instant Glow' is said and shown.
